538:     func generateTTS(
539:         text: String,
540:         voice: String? = nil,
541:         speed: Double = Constants.TTS.defaultSpeed,
542:         language: String = Constants.TTS.defaultLanguage,
543:         includeVoiceCode: Bool = true,
544:         priority: TTSRequestPriority = .interactive,
545:         requestID: String? = nil
546:     ) async throws -> TTSResponse {
547:         // Compute locality is independent from the account/content route. TTS
548:         // is anonymous, so a mainland user may use the filed CN compute ingress
549:         // without moving or exposing the account's cms_ session.
550:         let sanitized = SpeechTextSanitizer.sanitizedForTTS(text)
551:         guard SpeechTextSanitizer.containsSpeakableContent(sanitized) else {
552:             throw APIError.serverError("No speakable text for TTS")
553:         }
554:         let canonicalLanguage = SupportedTTSLanguage.canonicalCode(language)
555:         let requestedVoice = voice ?? ""
556:         let featureSafeVoice = !Constants.Features.voiceCloningEnabled && requestedVoice.hasPrefix("vc_")
557:             ? ""
558:             : requestedVoice
559:         let resolvedVoice = VoiceCatalog.resolvedVoice(
560:             preferred: featureSafeVoice,
561:             for: canonicalLanguage
562:         )
563:         // Clone compatibility endpoint accepts at most 600 JavaScript UTF-16
564:         // units. Preserve the local tail and append it to the server's own
565:         // continuation so a long paragraph is never silently truncated.
566:         let isClonedVoice = resolvedVoice.hasPrefix("vc_")
567:         let requestChunk = isClonedVoice
568:             ? ClonedTTSRequestChunker.split(sanitized, maxUTF16Length: 600)
569:             : ClonedTTSRequestChunker.Chunk(input: sanitized, remainder: "")
570:         let inputText = requestChunk.input
571:         let ttsRequest = TTSRequest(
572:             input: inputText,
573:             voice: resolvedVoice,
574:             speed: speed,
575:             language: canonicalLanguage,
576:             includeVoiceCode: includeVoiceCode
577:         )
578:         let bodyData = try JSONEncoder().encode(ttsRequest)
579:         apiDebugLog("[TTSRoute] language=\(canonicalLanguage) voice=\(resolvedVoice) clone=\(resolvedVoice.hasPrefix("vc_") ? "Y" : "N")")
580: 
581:         if isClonedVoice {
582:             // Clone synthesis stays on the authenticated account gateway. The
583:             // gateway owns compute authorization and returns the same captioned
584:             // JSON contract as preset voices.
585:             let response = try await requestClonedVoiceTTS(
586:                 body: bodyData,
587:                 voiceID: resolvedVoice,
588:                 priority: priority,
589:                 requestID: requestID ?? UUID().uuidString
590:             )
591:             return ClonedTTSRequestChunker.appendingLocalRemainder(
592:                 to: response,
593:                 submittedInput: inputText,
594:                 localRemainder: requestChunk.remainder
595:             )
596:         }
597: 
598:         let route = ComputeRouting.current
599:         guard let url = URL(
600:             string: TTSEndpoint.partlyURL(base: route.apiGatewayBaseURL)
601:         ) else {
602:             throw APIError.invalidURL
603:         }
604:         return try await request(
605:             url,
606:             method: "POST",
607:             body: bodyData,
608:             session: ttsSessions[route]
609:         )

197:         for requestUnit in requestUnits {
198:           var remainingText = requestUnit
199:           while SpeechTextSanitizer.containsSpeakableContent(remainingText) {
200:             guard currentRequestId == requestId else {
201:                 throw TTSError.cancelled
202:             }
203: 
204:             do {
205:                 ttsDebugLog("[TTSService] 📊 Cloud TTS request #\(segmentIndex): \(remainingText.prefix(50))...")
206: 
207:                 let response = try await APIService.shared.generateTTS(
208:                     text: remainingText,
209:                     voice: voice,
210:                     speed: speed,
211:                     language: language,
212:                     includeVoiceCode: includeVoiceCode,
213:                     requestID: cloneSubrequestID(
214:                         base: cloneRequestID,
215:                         segmentIndex: segmentIndex
216:                     )
217:                 )
